asset.reusable_precheck: Separate action-tool affordances from native policy/output instructions, then qualify exact one-action realization on synthetic fixtures before scientific execution.
asset.does_not_imply: PACTA mechanism failure, generic structured-action-projection failure, first-action uptake failure, or terminal utility failure
asset.scope: PACTA-v1.1 single-variable schema-extraction revision and its fresh seven-template Pilot only.

scientific_belief_update.increase: Tool-affordance extraction repairs inherited native response-envelope contamination.
scientific_belief_update.decrease: Synthetic schema fixtures alone do not establish one-action realization on full scientific packets.
scientific_belief_update.withhold: PACTA mechanism, SAP benefit, uptake, and utility remain untested.

asset.institutional_lesson: Passing a native system instruction as an action schema can cause the projector to follow a stronger inherited response envelope. Action-schema qualification must separate tool affordance specification from policy/output instructions before scientific execution.
asset.adaptation_novelty_lesson: An existing method adapted from problem A must not be relabeled as novelty for problem B. Novelty must reside in the additional mechanism required by the adaptation failure.
asset.reopen_condition: Do not tune or resume PACTA-v1.1. A further method revision or independent-carrier design requires explicit new human authorization.
